text:
Type: small handwoven rag rug
Use: a soft spot by a bed, sink or door; bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, entryway
Style: bohemian, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: woven fabric strips, cotton warp threads tied at the corners
Colors: assorted mix, dark red, pink, navy and blue, or light white, green and aqua
Shape: small rectangle with streaky horizontal rag weave, tied string tassels at the corners, flat and thin, compact
Feel: casual, homey, colorful, crafted
Goes with: white walls, light wood, colorful textiles; farmhouse, bohemian or cottage kitchens and bathrooms
